The dinosaur was recently named through Pledge and Ralph Molnar in the year of 1980, another similar type of species was known to be Kakuru kujani, the Kakuru's generic name was obtained from the Rainbow Serpent of Australian Aboriginal mythology and its generic name was obtained by the local aboriginal tribe known to be the Kujani or also Guyani.
